verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core function is to sync data into customer-owned warehouses/lakes 'in open table formats' (fivetran-docs-6), meaning the underlying data is not held hostage by Fivetran and lives in an open format the customer controls; the REST API also lets you manage/export pipeline configs programmatically (fivetran-docs-3, fivetran-docs-22). However, there is no explicit documentation of a full data-export/exit workflow, no mention of exporting connector configurations or transformation logic as portable open-format artifacts, and no independent confirmation that switching away from Fivetran is frictionless. Missing for 10: explicit 'export and leave' documentation, evidence on config/schema portability, and independent corroboration of low lock-in.
